sentence: The ___ campaign will target young professionals in major cities.
explanation: 'Advertising campaign' is the standard noun phrase.

sentence: Our sales representatives will ___ the new product at the trade show.
explanation: 'Demonstrate' means to show how something works.

sentence: The survey results will help us ___ customer preferences.
explanation: 'Identify' means to recognize and name.

sentence: Customers may return any item that does not ___ their expectations.
explanation: 'Meet expectations' is the standard collocation.

sentence: The store is offering a limited-time ___ on all winter coats.
explanation: A noun is needed after 'a limited-time'.

sentence: Ms. Torres was ___ for her outstanding customer service.
explanation: 'Commended for' means praised for.

sentence: We value your ___, so please complete the online questionnaire.
explanation: 'Feedback' means opinions about a product or service.

sentence: The company hopes to ___ its market share in Southeast Asia.
explanation: 'Expand market share' means to make it larger.

sentence: The new brochure highlights the main ___ of our latest model.
explanation: 'Features' are notable characteristics of a product.

sentence: To ___ customer loyalty, the store introduced a points program.
explanation: 'Encourage loyalty' means to promote it.

sentence: Sales of the new smartphone have exceeded all ___.
explanation: 'Exceeded expectations' is a standard collocation.

sentence: The marketing team is ___ a survey to gather customer opinions.
explanation: 'Conduct a survey' means to carry one out; the progressive form needs 'conducting'.

sentence: This offer is ___ to new customers only.
explanation: 'Restricted to' means limited to.

sentence: We guarantee ___ delivery within two days of your order.
explanation: An adjective is needed before the noun 'delivery'.

sentence: The shop is well known for its wide ___ of imported cheeses.
explanation: 'A wide selection of' means a large variety.

sentence: Customers who sign up before June 30 will ___ a free gift.
explanation: 'Receive a gift' is the natural collocation.

sentence: The ___ of our products is checked by a team of inspectors.
explanation: 'Quality' is what is inspected; 'quality of products' is standard.

sentence: The cosmetics firm launched an ___ range of organic skin-care products.
explanation: 'Extensive' means wide in scope, and an adjective is needed before 'range'.

sentence: Please allow ten days for the order to ___.
explanation: 'Arrive' fits an order reaching the customer.

sentence: The restaurant's popularity ___ after it was reviewed in a national newspaper.
explanation: 'Soared' means rose sharply.

sentence: We apologize for the ___ and will refund the full price.
explanation: 'We apologize for the inconvenience' is a standard phrase.

sentence: A satisfied customer is more ___ to recommend our services to friends.
explanation: 'Be likely to' + verb means probable.

sentence: The company ___ a loyal customer base over many years.
explanation: The simple past 'built' fits with a direct object; the other options are not grammatical here.

sentence: The coupon is ___ for use until the end of the year.
explanation: 'Valid' means legally acceptable or usable.

sentence: Our store provides free ___ for all furniture purchases.
explanation: 'Assembly' is a noun for putting together; 'free assembly' is a standard offer.

sentence: The new ad shows the product in a ___ light.
explanation: 'In a favorable light' is a fixed expression.

sentence: The company launched a ___ to attract more online customers.
explanation: A 'campaign' is a planned set of marketing activities.

sentence: Representatives are available to ___ any questions about your order.
explanation: 'Answer' takes a direct object ('questions') without a preposition.

sentence: Customer complaints are ___ handled by our support department.
explanation: An adverb is needed before the past participle 'handled'.

sentence: The mall's new tenants will ___ more shoppers to the area.
explanation: 'Attract shoppers' means to draw them in.

sentence: A well-known actor will ___ our new line of sports shoes.
explanation: 'Endorse a product' means to publicly support it for promotion.

sentence: Sales ___ at the store have increased since the new manager arrived.
explanation: 'Sales figures' is a standard noun phrase.

sentence: Our product is ___ to last for at least ten years.
explanation: 'Is designed to' means intended or built to.

sentence: Orders placed after 5 P.M. will be ___ the next business day.
explanation: Orders are 'processed', meaning handled administratively.

sentence: The brand's ___ image has helped it win a loyal following.
explanation: An adjective is needed before 'image'; 'distinctive' means unique and recognizable.

sentence: The retailer plans to ___ an online store next spring.
explanation: 'Launch a store' means to start it.

sentence: Because of ___ demand, the product is currently out of stock.
explanation: An adjective is needed before the noun 'demand'.

sentence: Those who purchase a laptop will ___ a free carrying case.
explanation: 'Be given' is the passive form that fits 'will' + a free item.

sentence: The store clerk was ___ to help us find the right size.
explanation: 'Was happy to' is a standard adjective + infinitive structure.
